I've re-read both calendars. Now I will re-check my analysis of their common availability.

**Priya Raman's Busy Times:**
- Mon: 10:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
- Tue: 9:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:30
- Wed: 9:00-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 9:30-10:00, 10:30-17:00
- Fri: 9:00-11:00, 12:00-13:00, 13:30-14:00, 14:30-17:00

**Marcus Hale's Busy Times:**
- Mon: 10:00-11:00, 11:30-17:00
- Tue: 9:00-11:00, 11:30-13:00, 14:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
- Wed: 9:30-12:00, 12:30-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00
- Thu: 9:00-10:00, 10:30-12:00, 12:30-13:30, 14:00-17:00
- Fri: 9:00-11:00, 12:00-14:30, 15:00-17:00

Now, let's find the common free slots again, being extra careful. A 30 minute slot is free if the 30 minute duration is free for both partners.

**Monday, Nov 16:**
- Priya is free: 9:00-10:00, 13:00-14:00. That's 9:00, 9:30, 13:00, 13:30.
- Marcus is free: 9:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30. That's 9:00, 9:30, 11:00, 15:00.
- Common: 9:00, 9:30. My previous analysis was correct.

**Tuesday, Nov 17:**
- Priya is free: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00. That's 10:30, 13:00, 13:30, 14:30, 16:30.
- Marcus is free: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00. That's 11:00, 13:00, 13:30, 15:30, 16:30.
- Common: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30. My previous analysis was correct.

**Wednesday, Nov 18:**
- Priya is free: 15:00-16:00. That's 15:00, 15:30.
- Marcus is free: 9:00-9:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00. That's 9:00, 12:00, 14:00, 15:00, 15:30.
- Common: 15:00, 15:30. My previous analysis was correct.

**Thursday, Nov 19:**
- Priya is free: 9:00-9:30, 10:00-10:30. That's 9:00, 10:00.
- Marcus is free: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30, 13:30-14:00. That's 10:00, 12:00, 13:30.
- Common: 10:00. My previous analysis was correct.

**Friday, Nov 20:**
- Priya is free: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30. That's 11:00, 11:30, 13:00, 14:00.
- Marcus is free: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00. That's 11:00, 11:30, 14:30.
- Common: 11:00, 11:30. My previous analysis was correct.

My initial analysis was correct. There is no overlap between the available slots for Priya/Marcus and Elena/David.

Now I will write to Brad. I will tell him that I have double-checked the calendars and there is no overlap. I will share my list of available slots again, and I will ask him to also double-check the calendars on his side. This will be my third action for this session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
